settings.clock: host inputs to the device, the call, the result back on the host, synchronized
settings.config: the board's own settings (no NVIDIA harness entry)
settings.numeric_mode: identical (the only tier the neural surface builds)
settings.opponent_mode: torch at every fast setting it supports on this box, one arm each (eager/compile x fp32/tf32/bf16 autocast; tools/torch_lm_step_opponent.py COLUMNS); the arm name carries the setting
settings.ours_call: mojolearn.linalg.matmul_bf16(a_bf16, b_bf16) (bf16 bits made before the clock)
settings.seed_rule: seed 7: every parameter and input of every arm comes from the conductor's default_rng(7) file; torch arms also call torch.manual_seed(7); ours' neural classes take no seed argument (nothing in them draws)

split floors: ours takes min_split_gain and min_child_hessian off the symmetric grower only, so here ours and CatBoost have no hessian floor or gain threshold; XGBoost min_child_weight 0, gamma 0, LightGBM min_split_gain 0
